build_fconv_language_model: build a FConvLanguageModel instance using build_model with args and a fairseq task
add_args_fconv_lm_parser: add model-specific CLI arguments like dropout and decoder-layers to an argparse parser
configure_base_lm_architecture: configure default fconv_lm architecture with 128-dim embeddings and 13 convolutional layers

configure_gbw_architecture: configure the dauphin GBW architecture with residual convolutional layers and adaptive softmax
